decisions.rationale: SD-LIVE-VIEW / SDPV-01: fixed HTTP asset delivery and SVG hierarchy layout are rendering/I-O mechanics. create_server serves the local page and snapshot adapter; it does not infer meaning or choose eligibility. Browser observation verifies initial rendering. No Specification is added merely for layout.

SD-LIVE-REFRESH / SDPV-02,05: poll timing is browser mechanics; the stable current/empty/stale/unavailable distinction and refusal to reinterpret a lost saved head as a new empty sketch are named policies. NotesPreview prepares immutable facts and consumes these rules through display_state; focused tests cover their outcomes and recovery. The 100-node browser profile remains unverified.

SD-LIVE-FIDELITY / SDPV-03: NotesPreview projects the existing read_notes revision, IDs, hierarchy, text, links and source attribution without semantic rewriting. Browser textContent/SVG text rendering preserves inert text. This is data projection/presentation, not a new authority decision; canonical false remains the existing note boundary. Original-source inspection was observed; hostile-text browser execution remains unverified.

SD-LIVE-SCOPE / SDPV-04,06: the fixed GET/HEAD asset and snapshot routes, loopback socket and rejected HTTP mutation/path requests are protocol and I/O boundary mechanics. No editing, approval, history-selection or canonical writer is invoked. Tests verify no note-file mutation and route rejection; UI observation shows current-only controls. New permission/semantic policy is deliberately not introduced.
